offer.text: Oh — hello! Nobody asks me for much. My knees ache too badly for the orchard, though. Could you fetch me 6 apples?

accept.text: Truly? How kind. Sweet ones, if you can.

decline.text: That's alright. People are busy. I understand.

in_progress.text: Did you find any apples, friend?

ready.text: Six lovely apples! You remembered an old soul.

complete.text: Sit with me sometime, won't you? It gets quiet out here.
